data.one_liner: Share text, links or files to a specific WhatsApp contact from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets you send messages, URLs or local files directly to a chosen WhatsApp contact on Android. It handles the necessary Android file provider configuration and supports Business WhatsApp.
use_when: You need to share content to a specific WhatsApp contact from an Android app
You want a simple API without handling generic share intents
avoid_when: You prefer a generic share sheet
strengths: Simple, single‑method API for messages and files
data.setup_notes: Add a FileProvider to AndroidManifest.xml and create res/xml/provider_paths.xml as shown in the README. No build_runner or codegen needed.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic sharing across platforms, including WhatsApp, without manual provider setup.
